metadata.title: libfpv: FPV drone in any game
metadata.description: libfpv drops a real FPV quadcopter, running real Betaflight firmware, into any game: Super Mario 64, GTA IV, GTA San Andreas, Vice City, Portal 2 and more. Free and open source.
metadata.keywords: libfpv, FPV, drone, quadcopter, Betaflight, game mod, GTA, Mario 64, Portal 2, open source

hero.title: FPV Drone in <accent>Any Game</accent>
hero.lead: Real Betaflight firmware flying across the games you knowwell. libfpv puts anFPV drone into Mario, GTA, Portal and any other 3D game you can imagine. Free and open source.

games.title: {count, plural, one {# game} other {# games}}. <muted>One real quad.</muted>
games.description: The same libfpv drone, with the same Betaflight tune, flies in every one of them, and its features (further down) are libfpv's, not one game's. What changes is the world: each mod hooks the game's own collisions, people, hazards and police. That's what each game's list shows.
games.shared: Plus the whole libfpv drone, the same as in every other game here: Betaflight, the OSD, the radio setup, presets and more.

next.title: Your game next?
next.body: Every game here is a mod built on libfpv, and the list keeps growing. Patrons get a place in the priority queue for picking which game gets a drone next, and they play it first.

sm64.subtitle: Mario has a drone now
sm64.pitch: Mario deploys a quad and stays behind as the pilot. Fly the castle grounds and every painting's world at real scale, where Mario is 1.6<nbsp></nbsp>m tall.
highlights: Fly through coins, stars, keys and 1-ups to collect them; a star ends the flight with Mario's dance
Ram Goombas, Koopas, Bullies and Bob-ombs to knock them out
Each level has its own breeze, and Fwooshes blow the drone away as they blow Mario
Lava, flames, Amps and Bob-omb blasts break the props
requirements: For the web build: nothing but a browser
On PC: your own Super Mario 64 ROM, to build the game from source with libfpv
Windows, Linux or macOS (with a Mac app bundle)

gtaiv.subtitle: Liberty City from above
gtaiv.pitch: Niko launches a quad from the street in front of him. Dive between Liberty City's skyscrapers and chase traffic down its avenues.
highlights: Collides with buildings, cars, peds and props through the engine's own physics probe
A fast hit ragdolls a ped, dents a car or shoves a prop
Liberty City streams in around the drone wherever you fly
requirements: GTA IV: The Complete Edition, version 1.2.0.59 (Steam)

gtasa.subtitle: From Grove Street to Las Venturas
gtasa.pitch: CJ launches a quad from the ground in front of him. Fly over Grove Street, out across the desert and between the casinos of Las Venturas.
highlights: Gangs, peds and the police react to the drone; with a wanted level, the cops shoot at it
Rain and sandstorms blow hard, police helicopters push you down, explosions shove you
Bullets, molotov fires, water and helicopter rotors break the props
Fly through a replay (F1, F3) or a world frozen by a photo mod
requirements: GTA San Andreas 1.0 US, the version nearly every PC mod needs: Steam and Rockstar Launcher copies need a downgrade first
An ASI loader; Modloader is recommended, then the mod lives in one folder

revc.subtitle: Native on Apple Silicon Macs
revc.pitch: A plugin for the macOS recompilation of Vice City. Tommy launches a quad from the ground and the neon city opens up below it. Self-contained: nothing else to install.
highlights: The drone picks up Vice City's pickups and flies through doors into its interiors
Peds and the police react to it as they would to Tommy
A fast hit hurts a ped as if Tommy rammed them, or dents a car
Runs next to Hammerill Trainer: both load from the same launcher
requirements: A Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or later)
GTA Vice City for macOS (reVC), in Applications
Nothing else: the installer puts libfpv into the app

portal2.subtitle: The drone is the portal gun
portal2.pitch: Solve Aperture's test chambers by quad. Fire portals from the camera, dive into a floor portal and come out of a wall with all your momentum.
highlights: Press pedestal buttons from the air, and doors open for the drone
Hook a cube under the drone on a winch line and lower it onto a button
Turrets shoot at the drone, lasers burn its props, goo drowns it
Faith plates launch it, excursion funnels carry it, fizzlers fizzle it
requirements: Portal 2 on Steam, kept up to date. Single player
Windows: no other mods or tools needed
Mac with Apple Silicon: Portal 2 Natif, built by source-recomp from your Steam copy

rdr2.subtitle: The frontier from above, 1899
rdr2.pitch: Arthur puts a quad down on the ground in front of him. Chase wagons across the plains, skim the rivers and thread the pines of the frontier.
highlights: Lawmen and enemies see, chase and shoot at the drone, while Arthur waits at the piloting spot with a little box in his hands, the closest thing 1899 has to a radio
A fast hit knocks people and horses over, with Arthur as the culprit: witnesses and the law react
Wind from the game's weather, calm in the lee of buildings; explosions shove the drone
Water, fire, explosions and bullets break the props, and a drone that lands on a moving wagon rides along
requirements: Red Dead Redemption 2 on PC (Steam, Epic or Rockstar Launcher), story mode
ScriptHookRDR2 by Alexander Blade, with its ASI loader

features.title: It flies like the real thing. Because it is.
features.description: These are libfpv's features, not one game's. Every libfpv mod ships the same FPV simulator inside, so what you see in one game's clip works in the others too. Press F8 in any of them to open the overlay: radio setup, rates, tuning, OSD, camera, the Betaflight CLI.

betaflight.title: Betaflight in the loop
betaflight.body: Not a lookalike: the real Betaflight 2025.12 runs inside the game through SimITL. Rates, modes, filters, arming, air mode and turtle mode behave as on your quad, so the habits carry over to the real one. Paste a diff all from your drone, or connect Betaflight Configurator (desktop builds).

radio.title: Your radio, your gamepad
radio.body: Plug in your transmitter in USB joystick mode. A setup wizard maps arm, angle, beeper, turtle, air mode and OSD disable. Mods can put the game's own actions on your switches too. Gamepad and keyboard work as well.

stand-in.title: The world treats the drone as you
stand-in.body: Your character launches the drone and stays at the piloting spot, radio in hand. Fly away and the game plays against the drone as if it were the player: enemies and police go after it, doors, pickups and triggers react to it, and the map loads around it. On by default, off in F8.

pilot-view.title: Back to the pilot
pilot-view.body: F gives you the character back while the drone stays in the world, still flown by the radio. F7 returns to it, and Y puts the character right under the drone.

video.title: A real goggle feed
video.body: Fisheye lens and uptilt everywhere. Mods that draw libfpv's video feed add a 5.8<nbsp></nbsp>GHz link budget: snow, sparkles, torn lines and colour loss with range, walls and crashes, at the camera's own resolution and aspect. Digital links break up and freeze.

wind.title: Wind that fights back
wind.body: The game's weather becomes real wind: gustier up high, calm behind buildings and indoors, with rotor downwash and blast waves. Betaflight has to hold the quad against it.

damage.title: Props break like real ones
damage.body: Hard crashes break props and burn motors, and whatever would hurt the character (fire, water, bullets, explosions) breaks the props too. Damage can be turned off.

presets.title: Physics presets
presets.body: From a BetaFPV Air65 tiny whoop to a 7" long-range cruiser. Frame, motors, props, battery, VTX and camera are presets, with real cameras like the Caddx Ratel 2 and HDZero Nano 90.

osd.title: Full OSD with GPS
osd.body: Betaflight's own MAX7456 fonts, analog or HD. Speed, altitude, vario, distance and a home arrow pointing back to your character.

sound.title: Motor sound
sound.body: Synthesized motors and beeper. Heard from the pilot, the drone gets quieter far away and behind walls, with Doppler and echoes.
sound.pending: hearing the drone from the pilot

rc-link.title: An ExpressLRS link
rc-link.body: Optional: packets drop with range and walls, Betaflight shows RXLOSS and goes into failsafe, with LQ and RSSI on the OSD.

shared.title: One setup for every game
shared.body: Radio mappings, your Betaflight tune and settings live in one shared folder, so they follow you from game to game.

portals.title: Portals, pushes and cargo
portals.body: For games that have them: fly through linked portals with your momentum, get launched by pads, and carry things under the drone with their weight.

web.title: Fly from a link
web.body: A game with source available can ship its mod as a web page: game and libfpv compiled to WebAssembly, radio included. Nothing to install.

social.title: Short clips from every game.
social.description: New mods, new tricks, and a lot of crashes into famous buildings. Short videos of libfpv in games go up on YouTube, Instagram and TikTok first.

openSource.title: Made in the open, for the modding community.
openSource.body: libfpv is 100% open source and free. FPV pilots get to fly through the worlds they grew up with, and modders get a ready drone instead of writing a flight model from scratch. Read the code, file an issue, send a pull request, or build a mod of your own.

free.title: libfpv stays free
free.body: The simulator itself is 100% open source and free, and it will stay that way. No paywall, no locked features.

github.title: Every line on GitHub
github.body: The library and its patches to Betaflight and SimITL are public. So are all of today's game mods.

license.title: GPL-3.0, with MIT parts
license.body: libfpv embeds Betaflight, so it is GPL-3.0-or-later, and a mod that ships it is too. The header, client code, renderers and examples are also MIT: with a split build, where the simulation runs as a separate program, the mod's own code can use other terms.

integration.title: Open to every integration
integration.body: A plain C API, documented inline, loads from any engine or mod loader. Bring a drone to your favourite game, and share it however you like.

modders.title: Give your favourite game a drone.
modders.description: libfpv has no renderer of its own and a plain C API, so it loads from any engine or mod loader. The game supplies collision and draws the result; libfpv does everything else.

radio.title: Your radio
radio.body: Transmitter, gamepad or keyboard, read through an embedded SDL3 (the Gamepad API in a browser).

libfpv.title: libfpv
libfpv.body: Betaflight + physics stepped at 1<nbsp></nbsp>kHz, colliding with the game's world.

game.title: The game
game.body: Gets the drone's pose, cameras, OSD and sound, and draws the frame.

integration.title: Integration guide
integration.body: Hooks, shaders, lessons from real mods

publishing.title: Publishing
publishing.body: One ZIP or one link for players

support.title: Keep the props spinning.
support.description: libfpv is a 100% open source and free project built by one<nbsp></nbsp>person with the help of the whole open source community. If it made you smile, put your quad through a Liberty City window, or saved your mod weeks of work, consider chipping in.
support.scan: Or scan the code from your phone.
support.oneTimeBody: Not into subscriptions? A single donation through Buy Me a Coffee goes straight into development time and new games.
support.footnote: libfpv itself stays free and open source no matter what. Support pays for development time, not for access to the simulator.

kamikaze.title: Kamikaze builds of the mods
kamikaze.body: Download the mods with the Kamikaze option on: bomb switches, impact or button detonation, explosion views.
kamikaze.note: Its code is open in libfpv: compile it yourself if you like. Not designed for military use.

early.title: Early access to new FPV mods
early.body: Fly the drone mods for other games before anyone else.

queue.title: The priority queue
queue.body: Your say comes first when the next game to mod is picked.

more.title: More games, better drone
more.body: Your contribution helps libfpv thrive and get integrated into more video games.

footer.about: A drop-in FPV quadcopter for any game, with real Betaflight firmware in the loop. Free and open source under GPL-3.0-or-later.
